theater: 伊朗高原西部·埃克巴塔那

battle.name: 居魯士大帝征服米底帝國
battle.theater: 伊朗高原西部·埃克巴塔那
battle.brief: 公元前六世紀中葉，安申之王居魯士起兵反對宗主米底王阿斯提亞格斯，雙方糾纏三年，最終在帕薩伽德擊潰米底大軍，埃克巴塔那城門內應而開，米底帝國就此易主。卡面埃及長矛雖未隨軍而至，但波斯與米底步兵那種木杆加金屬矛頭、靠密集矛陣頂住騎兵衝撞的做法，正是這場戰爭裡的關鍵。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 這場戰爭本質上是阿契美尼德家族的安申與帕爾薩聯軍，對抗其宗主米底帝國的內戰式對決。米底一方以埃克巴塔那（今伊朗哈馬丹）為都，阿斯提亞格斯是米底最後的國王，號稱統轄從呂底邊境直到帕提亞與波斯高原的宗主；依希羅多德的記載，米底境內民族眾多，阿利卡尼人、阿扎提人、布薩人、馬吉人、莫納德斯人等各成軍隊，另有數量可觀的附庸部隊與弓手。米底軍隊以騎兵見長，彌漫草原的米底騎兵能馳騁中射箭，是伊朗高原最具攻擊性的兵種；步兵則以持矛線陣與藤盾為骨架，弓手居兩翼掩護。波斯一方人數遠少，卻握有縱深與獨立兵源：居魯士二世是安申之王、帕薩伽德的君主，旗下有波斯步兵、帕提亞與巴克特里亞的弓騎、薩迦等北方部落的散兵，以及尚未編入帝國的呂底與小亞細亞勢力。居魯士沒有正面攻打埃克巴塔那的七層城牆，而是靠三年持久戰中拉攏的米底貴族與哈帕古斯的倒戈取勝；戰役因此以奪取首都與改換王室告終，而不是以屠城與毀堡告終。
countriesEn: This war was in essence a civil war fought between the Achaemenid houses of Anshan and Parsa and their overlord, the Median Empire. The Median side had its capital at Ecbatana, modern Hamadan in Iran. Astyages was the last king of Media and claimed overlordship from the Lydian frontier all the way to Parthia and the Persian highlands. According to Herodotus, Media itself was a patchwork of peoples — the Aricani, the Azati, the Busae, the Magi, the Monades and others — each contributing its own contingent, on top of the tribute levies of the subject nations and a large body of archers. The Median army was famous for its cavalry: Median riders on the grasslands of the Iranian plateau could shoot from the gallop and were the most aggressive fighting arm in the region. The Median infantry was built on a different frame, a line of spearmen backed by wicker shields, with archers on the flanks. Cyrus's Persians were far fewer in number but held depth and independent sources of troops: Cyrus II was king of Anshan and ruler of Pasargadae, and his forces included Persian infantry, the horse-archers of Parthia and Bactria, irregulars from northern tribes such as the Saka, and the Lydian and minor Anatolian contingents not yet absorbed into any empire. Cyrus never assaulted the seven-terraced walls of Ecbatana head on. He won through the Median nobles he won over during three years of attritional war and through the defection of Harpagus. The campaign therefore ended in the seizure of a capital and the transfer of a crown, not in the sack of a city.
people: 核心人物是阿斯提亞格斯、居魯士二世與哈帕古斯。阿斯提亞格斯是米底末代國王，既是居魯士的祖父，也是他的監護人兼宗主；他依編年史記載先行進攻「安申之王」居魯士，把對方的起兵壓在安申高原，最後兵敗被俘。居魯士二世約生於前六〇〇年，母親曼達涅是阿斯提亞格斯之女，前五五九年父喪後繼安申王位，一直以「安申之王」的名義向米底稱臣；他的長處不在單挑，而在聯姻、策反與持久戰，戰前已把哈帕古斯這樣的米底主將拉到自己一方。哈帕古斯出身米底貴族，是阿斯提亞格斯最倚重的將軍，卻在戰爭中倒戈，並帶走部分米底軍隊與一批貴族；希羅多德另記有七名米底貴族結盟密謀對抗國王，事成之後，正是這批人在城門開啟一事上起了作用。居魯士的親族阿爾薩梅斯原為帕爾薩的小王，征服後改任總督；其妻康斯坦妮出身阿契美尼德家族；阿斯提亞格斯之女阿米提斯在征服後嫁與居魯士，這門婚姻安撫了帕提亞、巴克特里亞與薩迦等附庸。留下文字的人有兩位：巴比倫王那波尼德的編年史是僅存的一手材料，希羅多德與克忒西亞斯則是兩千年間最重要的二手敘述。米底馬吉祭司團在整個事件中角色微妙：他們既是阿斯提亞格斯統治的宗教支柱，也在王朝崩解時選擇了新秩序，此後成為帝國祭祀的權威。
peopleEn: The three central figures are Astyages, Cyrus II and Harpagus. Astyages was the last king of Media, and at once the grandfather and the guardian and overlord of Cyrus. The chronicle records that he struck first against Cyrus, king of Anshan, driving the rising back into the Anshan highlands, and he was finally taken prisoner after his army was beaten. Cyrus II was born about 600 BC, his mother Mandane being a daughter of Astyages; on his father's death in 559 BC he succeeded to the throne of Anshan and remained, in his own titulature, the king of Anshan acknowledging Median overlordship. His strength was not in single combat but in marriage politics, in subversion and in protracted war, and before the fighting began he had already drawn Harpagus, a leading Median commander, to his side. Harpagus was of the Median nobility and was the general Astyages trusted most, yet he changed sides during the war and brought over part of the Median army and a body of the nobles. Herodotus separately records a conspiracy of seven Median nobles against the king, and it was these men who afterwards made the opening of the gates possible. Among Cyrus's kinsmen, Arsames had been the lesser king of Parsa and became a satrap after the conquest; his wife Cassandane was herself an Achaemenid; and Amytis, Astyages's daughter, married Cyrus after the victory, a match that pacified such tributaries as the Parthians, the Bactrians and the Saka. Two writers left us the story: the chronicle of the Babylonian king Nabonidus is the only first-hand document, while Herodotus and Ctesias are the two most important second-hand accounts of the two thousand years that followed. The Median Magi played a subtle part in all of it: they were the religious pillar of Astyages's rule, and when the dynasty broke they chose the new order, becoming the custodians of imperial worship.
kits: 卡面那支埃及長矛屬於早王朝時期，形制是銅或青銅矛頭綁紮在木杆上，用途是守城垣，也用來收復失地；它並沒有出現在米底高原的任何一次接觸中，但它代表的那一類武器——木杆加金屬矛頭、可以支撐線陣的長矛——正是波斯與米底步兵裝備的原型。米底與波斯步兵的長矛杆前後都裝有金屬：前端是矛頭，後端是尾鐏，一旦盾牌破損，矛尾仍可當短兵器使用；步兵另配藤編盾牌，大型長方形的一種可以插在地上替弓手遮蔽箭雨，小型月牙形則便於隨身攜帶，另有阿基納塞斯短劍與北伊朗常見的戰斧。弓箭是伊朗的國家武器，弓長約一米，箭為蘆管、裝鐵或青銅箭頭；鎧甲只配給美索不達米亞與埃及籍部隊，波斯人多戴金屬頭盔。米底騎兵的裝束最具辨識度：尖頂氈帽、束腰短衣、窄褲與長靴，馬具簡陋而耐操，弓、矛與短劍隨身攜帶。車兵在阿契美尼德軍中已退居象徵地位，多用於儀仗與搬運；真正支撐戰役後勤的是馬匹、馱馬、輜重車與駱駝隊。攻城器械在這場戰爭裡基本沒有派上用場：埃克巴塔那不是被攻破的，而是被交出來的。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card belongs to the early dynastic period, a copper or bronze head lashed to a wooden shaft, used to hold city walls and later to recover lost ground. It did not appear in any single contact on the Median highlands, but the class of weapon it stands for — a wooden shaft with a metal head, a long spear able to hold a line — is precisely the prototype of the Median and Persian infantry arm. The long spear of Median and Persian foot soldiers carried metal at both ends: a head at the front and a butt spike at the rear, so that once a shield broke the shaft could still be used as a short weapon. The infantry also carried wicker shields, some large and rectangular, which could be planted in the ground to shelter archers, and some small and crescent-shaped for those on the move, together with the acinaces short sword and the battle axe common in northern Iran. The bow was Iran's national weapon, roughly a metre long, fired reed arrows tipped with iron or bronze. Body armour was issued only to Mesopotamian and Egyptian contingents, while Persians generally wore metal helmets. The Median cavalryman's dress was the most recognisable of all: a conical felt hat, a belted tunic, close trousers and high boots, with simple and durable tack, and bow, spear and short sword carried on the person. Chariots had already become symbolic in the Achaemenid army and were used for parade and for carrying loads; what really sustained the logistics of the campaign were the horses, the pack animals, the baggage wagons and the camel trains. Siege engines played almost no part in this war: Ecbatana was not stormed, it was handed over.
tactics: 居魯士的戰術核心是「不打不可攻之城」。埃克巴塔那倚七層階梯式城牆與山勢而建，正面強攻代價太高，他因此把三年光陰用在三件事上：策反米底貴族、以小股襲擊消耗米底軍隊、等待對方陣線出現裂痕。希羅多德記述的陣前部署最見用心：米底人不習慣馬上作戰，也不習慣面對密集的矛兵，居魯士便在步兵方陣之前排上戰車與輜重車，車陣與盾牆構成一道壁障，使米底騎兵衝散陣形之後無法反手；精銳步兵則收在陣中，兩翼是波斯與附庸的弓騎，射擊與衝鋒分開進行。真正的破口不在戰力而在人心：哈帕古斯在關鍵交鋒中倒戈，率部分米底軍隊轉向自己的舊主；米底盟軍失去士氣，戰線在沒有正面崩潰的情況下瓦解。居魯士隨即封鎖帕薩伽德一線，切斷米底與呂底方向可能的聯繫，逼迫阿斯提亞格斯退守埃克巴塔那；最後由城內米底人開啟城門，城市未經強攻即落入居魯士之手。佔領之後，居魯士做了與屠城毀堡相反的選擇：不拆毀米底城堡，不屠居民，把米底騎兵整編進自己的軍隊，承認馬吉祭司的既有地位。戰役被拉長到三個年頭，本身也是一種戰術：冬季伊朗高原山道難行，糧秣靠安申與波斯高原的據點分批輸送，兩軍在冬春各自整頓，勝負只在可以行軍的季節決定。
tacticsEn: The core of Cyrus's method was that he refused to attack a city that could not be assaulted. Ecbatana was built on seven terraced walls against the mountain, and a frontal assault would have cost too much, so he spent three years on three tasks: turning Median nobles, wearing the Median army down with small incursions, and waiting for a crack to open in the enemy line. The deployment Herodotus describes is the most revealing part of it. The Medes were unused to fighting on horseback and unused to facing a dense spear formation, so Cyrus ranged chariots and baggage wagons in front of his infantry, so that the barricade of waggons and shields broke the Median charge and left the riders unable to turn back against it. His best infantry was held back in the centre, with Persian and subject horse-archers on the flanks, keeping shooting and shock separate. The real breach was not a matter of strength but of morale: Harpagus changed sides in the decisive clash and turned part of the Median army against its former master; the Median allies lost their nerve and the line came apart without a frontal collapse. Cyrus then closed the line at Pasargadae, cutting any link between Media and Lydia, and pressed Astyages back into Ecbatana, where the gates were opened from within and the city passed to Cyrus without assault. After the occupation Cyrus chose the opposite of sack and demolition: the Median fortifications were not razed, the population was not massacred, the Median cavalry was absorbed into his own army, and the existing standing of the Magi was recognised. Stretching the war across three campaigning years was itself a tactic: in winter the mountain tracks of the Iranian plateau are impassable, rations moved forward in instalments from depots in Anshan and the Persian highlands, both sides refitted in the winter and spring, and the decision was reached only in the season when armies could march.
data: 可以核對的數字有幾組。時間上，那波尼德編年史記錄米底與波斯的敵對至少延續三年，通行編年把起兵放在前五五三至前五五〇年；本卡採用的前五四七年，是早年依編年史某種解讀而得的舊式定年，近代學界多不採用，今日主流仍把米底帝國的覆亡放在前五五〇年。兵力上，希羅多德記載阿斯提亞格斯在帕薩伽德一役集結十萬大軍；同一書記載米底一方的密謀者為七名貴族；關於城市，希羅多德描述埃克巴塔那的城牆有七層，層層遞寬，宮殿建在最高的一層台地上，坡度極陡。役後居魯士在位至前五三〇年，楔形文字材料記下他於前五三〇年十二月去世。制度上，波斯在戰後建立萬人隊一萬人作為常備核心，另有總督與貢賦制度。以年代相減，本卡的定年距滅巴比倫的前五三九年約八年，距滅呂底的前五四六年約一年。月份方面，現存史料只記年不記月，卡面所列的起始月並無文獻依據。
dataEn: A few sets of figures can be checked. On timing, the chronicle of Nabonidus records at least three years of hostility between Media and Persia, and the received chronology places the rising between 553 and 550 BC. The 547 BC used on this card is an older dating derived from one reading of that chronicle; it is little held today, and the mainstream position still puts the fall of the Median Empire in 550 BC. On numbers of men, Herodotus records that Astyages mustered a hundred thousand for the battle at Pasargadae, and the same book names seven Median nobles as conspirators. On the city, Herodotus describes the walls of Ecbatana as seven courses, each wider than the one below, with the palace on the highest terrace and the slope extremely steep. After the campaign Cyrus ruled until 530 BC, and cuneiform evidence records his death in December 530 BC. Institutionally, Persia built the Ten Thousand as a standing core after the war, together with the satrapy and the tribute system. Working backwards from the dates, the dating used on this card stands about eight years before the fall of Babylon in 539 BC and about a year before the fall of Lydia in 546 BC. As to the month, the surviving sources record the year and not the month, so the starting month listed on the card rests on no documentary basis.
cause: 起義的根子在家臣國與宗主國的關係。米底自亞述帝國衰亡後成為伊朗高原的主權者，安申與帕爾薩不過是附庸；但阿契美尼德家族有自己的高原王國、自己的兵源與縱深，形同一個可以隨時抽身的附屬國。那波尼德編年史記阿斯提亞格斯先主動進攻「安申之王」居魯士，把衝突挑在米底家門內；希臘方面的說法則把導火線放在居魯士被派領兵遠征巴比倫一事上——他藉握兵權之便，在波斯與米底的姻親網絡中經營反叛。希羅多德另記阿斯提亞格斯曾夢見洪水與結果的葡萄藤從女兒曼達涅的骨盆湧出，遍覆國土，佔卜者斷言外孫將篡位；夢兆是神話式的說法，但它的政治內涵很清楚：王朝的恐懼來自血親。更實際的推力來自米底帝國本身的鬆散——中央權力之下有眾多部族與城市，地方貴族各有私兵，騎兵的強大仰賴土地與草場，一旦王帳的權威受損，聯盟就會瓦解。
causeEn: The roots of the rising lie in the relationship between vassal state and overlord. After the Assyrian empire had decayed, Media had become the dominant power on the Iranian plateau, and Anshan and Parsa were no more than its subjects; but the Achaemenid house had a kingdom of its own on the highlands, its own sources of men and its own depth of country, and so behaved like a dependency that could slip away at any moment. The chronicle of Nabonidus records that Astyages attacked Cyrus, king of Anshan, first, so that the quarrel was fought inside Media's own doorway; the Greek tradition instead places the spark in Cyrus's being appointed to lead an expedition against Babylon, and in his use of the command that came with it to work his revolt through the marriage ties of Persia and Media. Herodotus adds that Astyages dreamed of a flood, and then of fruiting vines, rising from the body of his daughter Mandane and covering the whole land, and the diviners read this as her grandson's coming seizure of the throne. The dream is a mythological way of putting things, but its political content is plain: the dynasty's fear came from blood. The more practical push came from the looseness of the Median state itself — many tribes and cities under a central power, private retainers held by the local nobility, and a cavalry whose strength rested on land and pasture. Once the authority of the royal tent was shaken, the alliance came apart.
impact: 米底帝國就此終結，阿契美尼德帝國從高原王國一躍成為近東的超級強權。居魯士接掌的並非空殼：他保留了米底的城市、宮殿、馬場與官僚，加以波斯式的家族結構與總督制，米底人成為帝國人數第二多的族群，貢賦與兵源負擔加重，卻也提供最重要的騎兵兵種與後方生產力。米底的馬吉祭司團被留用並取得國教地位，彌補了新王朝在宗教上的空白；波斯語與米底語彼此滲透，形成「波斯米底語」的混合層，這層混合在後來兩千年的伊朗高原上一直存在。帝國的框架也在此定型：「萬王之王」的稱號、總督制、按地域與族群編成的兵役與貢賦制度，以及以居魯士圓柱所宣示的對被征服廟宇與神廟的寬容態度，後世每一代波斯君主都援引這套敘事。連鎖的戰爭隨即展開：前五四六年滅呂底，前五三九年入巴比倫，四年後居魯士的兒子岡比西斯南征埃及。希臘人對這位敵手的記憶同樣深遠，色諾芬的《居魯士傳》把居魯士塑造成賢明立法者，幾乎成了西方政治傳說的原型。
impactEn: The Median Empire came to an end, and the Achaemenid state rose in a single step from a highland kingdom into a superpower of the Near East. What Cyrus took over was no empty shell: he kept the Median cities, the palaces, the horse-breeding grounds and the administration, and laid over them the Persian family structure and the satrapy. The Medes became the second largest people of the empire; they carried a heavier share of tribute and of man-power, and in return they furnished the most important arm of all, the cavalry, and the productive base behind it. The Median Magi were kept in place and given the standing of a state priesthood, filling the religious gap in the new dynasty. Persian and Median ran together into a mixed layer, a Median-Persian language that stayed with the Iranian plateau for the next two thousand years. The framework of the empire was fixed at this moment: the title of King of Kings, the satrapy, the levies and tribute organised by region and people, and the attitude of respect towards the temples and shrines of the conquered, proclaimed on the Cyrus Cylinder; every later Persian monarch quoted that narrative. The chain of wars followed at once: Lydia fell in 546 BC, Babylon in 539, and four years after that Cyrus's son Cambyses marched south into Egypt. Greek memory of the enemy was no shallower, and Xenophon's Cyropaedia turned Cyrus into a wise lawgiver, very nearly the archetype of the Western political legend.
result: 結果是米底的王室易主，帝國的疆域換了主人。阿斯提亞格斯在埃克巴塔那陷落時被俘，希羅多德與克忒西亞斯都記他沒有被殺，後來還娶了阿斯提亞格斯之女阿米提斯；哈帕古斯與七名米底貴族成為征服秩序的受益者，留在城內掌權。居魯士從「安申之王」改稱「波斯之王」，再以「巴比倫王」等頭銜自居；米底各城鎮沒有經過戰爭即歸順，米底騎兵整編為帝國骨幹，馬吉祭祀照舊，城堡也沒有被拆毀——這套做法換來的是沒有長期的米底叛亂與立即的報復循環。戰役的真正結局在更大範圍內：前六世紀中葉的一場高原內戰，成為一個橫跨安納托利亞到中亞的大帝國的起點，這帝國將延續到前三三〇年亞歷山大東征為止。唯一仍在爭議的是年份：本卡的定年取自舊式編年，較為可靠的說法是前五五〇年；若採本卡年數，則這場征服與呂底、巴比倫兩役的間隔都更緊。
resultEn: The outcome was a change of dynasty in Media and a change of masters over the territory. Astyages was taken prisoner when Ecbatana fell; both Herodotus and Ctesias record that he was not killed, and that he later married Astyages's daughter Amytis, so that Cyrus married the daughter of the man he had dispossessed. Harpagus and the seven Median nobles became the beneficiaries of the new order and stayed in the city to govern it. Cyrus changed his style from king of Anshan to king of Persia, and then assumed titles such as king of Babylon; the Median towns came over without a further war, the Median cavalry was reorganised into the backbone of the new army, the Magi kept their observances, and the fortifications were left standing. What that bought was the absence of prolonged Median revolt and of any immediate cycle of revenge. The truer ending lies on the larger scale: a highland civil war of the mid sixth century BC turned out to be the beginning of an empire stretching from Anatolia to Central Asia, an empire that was to run on until Alexander's eastward march in 330 BC. The only thing still disputed is the date: the year on this card follows the older chronology, while the better supported view is 550 BC. If the card's year is used, the intervals to the wars against Lydia and Babylon are correspondingly tighter.
